newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL noon rubber extends fall despite China interest.
newsitem.headline: KL noon rubber extends fall despite China interest.

text.p: Rubber prices in Malaysia continued their fall at noon session despite some fresh inquiries from Far East buyers, dealers said.

"Generally prices continued to fall further for some lower SMR grades," a dealer said. "Prices have fallen so much in recent days and the lower levels had attracted some inquiries from China for SMR 20 nearby shipment." Suppliers were offering SMR 20 at around 235 cents.
Other grades like SMR CV was quoted sellers at 303 cents, SMR L at 283, SMR 10 at 234.50 and latex at 200.
